core: Urea cycle citrulline and arginine synthesis
name: Urea cycle citrulline synthesis with ornithine transcarbamylase deficiency
rationale: All members concern the urea cycle step making citrulline and arginine, and the OTC deficiency variants separate it from neighbours built on ammonium homeostasis, ornithine metabolism or the other urea cycle enzyme deficiencies.

name: Vitamin K gamma-carboxylation and ascorbate metabolism
rationale: Members cover vitamin K metabolism and gamma-carboxylation of protein precursors plus vitamin C metabolism, transport and response (with vitamin E response), which separates it from neighbours centred on vitamin E/ubiquinol, vitamin D or oxygen transport.

name: Glutamine-family amino acid metabolism centred on proline
rationale: Members are general alpha/L-amino acid and glutamine-family metabolism terms anchored by proline biosynthesis and catabolism, which distinguishes it from neighbours built on glycine, glyoxylate, serine or organic acid metabolism.

qualifier: RHOA/B/C and CDC42 with formin activation
name: RHO and CDC42 GTPase cycles with formin activation
rationale: All members are RHO-subfamily and CDC42 GTPase cycles or their signalling, and the RHOA/B/C cycles and formin activation separate it from neighbours dominated by RAC, IQGAP, ROCK/PAK or RND/RHOU/V cycles.

qualifier: fungi and Gram-positive bacteria via antimicrobial proteins
name: Antimicrobial protein killing of fungi and Gram-positive bacteria
rationale: Members share direct host killing of microbes (antifungal humoral response, cytolysis, metal sequestration, neutrophil cytotoxicity), and the antifungal and Gram-positive focus separates it from neighbours on respiratory burst, iron assimilation, mucosal immunity or degranulation.

core: Golgi organization and COPI vesicle traffic
name: Golgi organization, COPI traffic and Rab/ARF GTPase regulation
rationale: Members cover Golgi assembly/disassembly, COPI and Golgi-ER retrograde traffic, vesicle tethering and Rab/ARF GTPase control, which separates it from neighbours centred on TGN-endosome-lysosome sorting, COPII export or Ral signalling.

name: Osmotic and electrolyte homeostasis via cation-chloride cotransporters
rationale: Members share cell volume, osmotic and Na/K/Cl balance including SLC12 cotransporter disorders, and the osmotic stress responses, Ca-activated K channels and chloride secretion distinguish it from neighbours built on P-type ATPases, Na/H exchangers, K2P channels or tight junctions.

name: MECP2 neuronal gene repression with sensory perception behaviors
rationale: Members centre on MECP2 control of neuronal genes (including its HDAC/NCoR repression and Rett-type defects) together with sensory behaviours, distinguishing it from neighbours of broad motor/social behaviour or glycinergic transmission that lack the MECP2 repression core.

name: Adenine nucleotide, phosphocreatine and NAD(P) cofactor metabolism
rationale: Members cover nucleotide di/triphosphate interconversion, mitochondrial ADP/ATP transport, creatine/phosphocreatine and NAD(P) synthesis, salvage and transport, which together separate it from neighbours each missing either the NAD, creatine or nucleotide-kinase arm.

qualifier: transcriptional control and red cell membrane assembly
name: Erythroid differentiation transcription and red cell membrane assembly
rationale: Members describe erythroid commitment and late erythroid maturation, its transcriptional regulators and red cell membrane building, distinguishing it from neighbours on stem cell homeostasis, primitive/definitive hemopoiesis or megakaryocyte development.

core: RNA polymerase II transcription cycle control
name: RNA polymerase II initiation-to-termination control with R-loop resolution
rationale: Members regulate Pol II transcription from preinitiation complex through elongation to termination, and the termination and R-loop processing terms separate it from neighbours on RNA processing/Pol I-III, polycomb chromatin, pausing or MYC targets.

name: B cell development and BCR signaling regulation
rationale: Members share B cell development, proliferation, homeostasis and B cell receptor signalling with its regulators (CD22, BTK, RAS), distinguishing it from neighbours built on B/plasma cell identity signatures or T cell differentiation.

name: Telomere capping and protection against end recombination
rationale: Members concern capping and packaging telomere ends and blocking recombination and NHEJ there, separating it from neighbours on telomerase recruitment or telomere C-strand replication and D-loop processing.

name: Stress granule assembly, mRNA stability and translational repression
rationale: Members combine stress granule dynamics, RNA-binding-protein control of mRNA stability and translational silencing, distinguishing it from neighbours centred on TTP/BRF1/KSRP destabilizers or deadenylation and decapping decay.

name: Canonical WNT signaling controlled by AXIN stability
rationale: Members all concern beta-catenin/TCF signalling and its destruction complex, and AXIN degradation and stabilization separate it from neighbours on DVL activation, FZD regulation or target gene repression.

name: Pancreatic beta cell insulin secretion and K-ATP channel control
rationale: Members cover regulation of insulin secretion by incretins, fatty acids, glucokinase, neurotransmitters and K-ATP channels plus insulin processing, separating it from neighbours on GLUT4 translocation, insulin receptor signalling or exocyst traffic.

qualifier: VEGF/Tie2 angiogenesis and smooth muscle phenotypic switching
name: VEGF angiogenesis and vascular smooth muscle phenotype switching
rationale: Members regulate endothelial VEGF/Tie2-driven sprouting angiogenesis and vascular smooth muscle proliferation, migration and phenotypic switching, distinguishing it from neighbours lacking the smooth muscle arm or the endothelial VEGF arm.

name: Planar cell polarity-driven convergent extension
rationale: All members concern planar cell polarity and the convergent extension it drives in gastrulation, axis elongation and neural plate, separating it from neighbours on axial mesoderm patterning or non-canonical WNT receptor trafficking.

qualifier: T and B cell with coreceptor tuning
name: T and B cell receptor signaling with coreceptor tuning
rationale: Members are TCR and BCR proximal signalling with CD28 costimulation and CTLA4/BTLA/CD22 inhibition, distinguishing it from T-cell-only activation neighbours and from a BCR neighbour lacking the costimulatory set.

core: Amino acid transport across plasma membrane
qualifier: neutral and acidic amino acid uptake
name: Neutral and acidic amino acid uptake across plasma membrane
rationale: Members cover plasma membrane amino acid transporters and their disorders (SLC6A19 Hartnup, SLC1A1 dicarboxylic aminoaciduria, SLC6A14), distinguishing it from neighbours on iminoglycinuria, cystinuria or peptide transport.

qualifier: cytosolic clearance and sarcoplasmic reticulum store control
name: Cytosolic calcium clearance and sarcoplasmic reticulum store control
rationale: Members lower cytosolic calcium by SR/ER uptake and Na/Ca exchange and restrain ryanodine-mediated release, distinguishing it from neighbours on stimulated calcium release or cardiac contraction.

name: Base excision repair and direct alkylation damage reversal
rationale: Members cover glycosylase-initiated and long-patch base excision repair plus ALKBH/MGMT alkylation reversal, separating it from neighbours on mismatch repair, interstrand cross-link repair or TET demethylation.

qualifier: cancer receptor/SMAD mutants and RUNX3 targets
name: TGF-beta superfamily SMAD signaling, cancer mutants and RUNX3
rationale: Members share TGF-beta/activin/BMP/AMH receptor-SMAD signalling, and the cancer-associated receptor and SMAD mutants with RUNX3 target regulation separate it from neighbours on extracellular ligand sequestration or BMP morphogen modules.

core: Bacterial ligand sensing and inflammatory cytokine production
name: TLR2/4-MyD88 sensing and NLRP3 inflammasome cytokine control
rationale: Members cover LPS/lipopeptide sensing through TLR2/4-MyD88-IRAK4, NLRP1/3 inflammasome IL-1 processing and regulation of inflammatory cytokines, distinguishing it from neighbours on pyroptosis/CASP4/5/AIM2, TRIF signalling or monocyte inflammatory modules.

name: Telomere maintenance via telomerase trafficking, replication and recombination
rationale: Members span telomerase Cajal-body trafficking, telomere replication, capping and recombination-based maintenance, distinguishing it from neighbours on general DNA double-strand break repair, PARP chromatin responses or oncogene-induced senescence.

name: Non-coding RNA methylation and snRNP/snoRNP biogenesis
rationale: Members cover methylation of rRNA, tRNA and snRNA caps with snRNP and box C/D snoRNP assembly and localization, separating it from neighbours on pseudouridylation or diphthamide/wybutosine synthesis.

name: Platelet activation and aggregation via soluble mediator receptors
rationale: Members share platelet activation, degranulation and aggregation driven by thrombin, ADP, thromboxane and prostacyclin receptors, distinguishing it from neighbours on integrin/Rap1 signalling or GPIb/collagen adhesion.

name: p53-dependent apoptosis via PUMA/NOXA and death gene transcription
rationale: Members concern p53 transcription of death genes and BH3-only PUMA/NOXA action driving cytochrome c release, separating it from neighbours on anoikis, negative regulation or BAX/BAK oligomerization.

name: Cerebellar and striatal development for motor coordination
rationale: Members share motor coordination behaviours with cerebellar layer and striatum formation, distinguishing it from neighbours on vocal/social learning, sensory behaviours or Bergmann glia and substantia nigra development.

name: RAF-MEK-ERK activation by oncogenic mutants and feedback inactivation
rationale: Members cover RAF/MEK/ERK activation by oncogenic RAS, RAF and MAP2K variants and its negative feedback and ERK dephosphorylation, distinguishing it from neighbours on RAS GAP regulation or SOS/RIT signalling.
